de_xuat_va_phan_bien.phan_bien: Doi lap: 'ORACLE thang thi chung to nen sua' — chua chac; ORACLE la ban co lieu KHAC (tran rong hon), nen no thang co the chi vi LIEU chu khong vi THONG TIN. Phai giu lieu bang nhau (cung so luot gan) giua ORACLE va SHUF thi phep so sanh moi tach duoc thong tin khoi lieu. ⚠ Va ban do lop §5.6 canh bao: kenh duong hien tai dang chay o diem van hanh DOI TRAN, tang lieu CO THE DAO DAU.
de_xuat_va_phan_bien.rui_ro: CAO ve ket luan. Phai prereg tieu chi PASS/NO-GO truoc khi chay.

de_xuat_va_phan_bien.phan_bien: Doi lap: 'thoi gian roi cua tai xe von da la 0 gia tri, ho dang cho khong'. Phan nao dung — nhung ho dang cho o CHO HO CHON, con day la he thong bao ho di 2,6 km. Ranh gioi san pham §5 noi ro he thong khong tu thuc thi thay tai xe; toi thieu phai DO va CONG BO cai gia do. ⚠ KHONG de xuat dua suc khoe/moi vao objective (spec §1.2b) — day la mot chi so BAO CAO, khong phai mot bien toi uu.
de_xuat_va_phan_bien.rui_ro: THAP (them chi so, khong doi hanh vi).

cai_chua_kiem: CO CHE cua phan chuyen giao 58,4% VAN CHUA BIET. Toi loai duoc gia thuyet 'chen o o dich' (S4-D6) nhung khong thay the duoc bang gia thuyet nao DA DO. Gia thuyet manh nhat con lai, CHUA KIEM: dispatcher phuc vu tu ban kinh ~2,22 km (`candidate_ring_k_max: 6`, `eta_max_min: 11`), nen mot tai xe di 2,596 km doi thu tu 'ai gan nhat' cho hang chuc o, ke ca o ma khong ai relocate den. Bang chung gian tiep, DERIVED va co canh bao don vi: o NHAN nguoi +24,67 don duoc nhan trong khi toan he chi +17,27 chuyen hoan thanh => co mot lo hut khoang −7 o CHO KHAC ma toi khong co lap duoc (hai so nay dem hai su kien khac nhau: `order_matched accepted` vs `dropoff`).
Toi KHONG chay `uv run pytest -q` va `uv run pytest -q ui/backend/tests`. Khong phat bieu nao o day dua tren trang thai suite.

Toi KHONG kiem lai `+6.016d` cua UPDATE-087 (goc da bao khong tai tao duoc). Toi chi tai tao duoc `+3.219d` cua goc: do lai doc lap ra +3.219d/nguoi/ngay = +289.730d/ngay/doi tren cung cua so seed 3300-3329.

Kiem cheo doc lap voi mm-08 (3 seed): toi do o n=30 duoc 30,3/90 = 33,7% doi hinh di chuyen >=1 lan/ngay va 52,3/90 = 58,1% duoc gan >=1 lan — nam trong dai 32,2-44,4% va 53,3-63,3% ma mm-08 bao. KHONG mau thuan.

S4-D3 la phep DO tren phan bo input thuc te (472 lo), KHONG phai chung minh rang greedy first-fit luon toi uu cho ma tran cost nay. Neu ai doi cost (them so hang khoang cach) thi ket luan nay HET HIEU LUC ngay lap tuc.

Phep do phoi nhiem (S4-D6) dung cua so ±bucket va panel `probe_wait_stats` chi chup tai xe dang IDLE tai bien bucket. Tai xe ban (dang chay don) khong xuat hien trong panel => phoi nhiem cua NHOM BAN gan nhu khong do duoc bang thuoc nay. Day co the la ly do phep thu am tinh.

Toi khong do gi tren duong SAN PHAM. Kenh vi tri bi D-004 cam o san pham; moi so o day la SIM voi mock data (`configs/pilot_dongda.yaml`, seed 3300-3329). Ban kinh anh huong hom nay = bang chung dung de quyet dinh ship, khong phai mot tinh nang tai xe dang dung.

Toi KHONG kiem lai B1 bang cach do lai histogram `slots = 0` (87,6-88,2%, 3 seed cua mm-08). Toi chi tu doc lai dong `slots = int(demand // trips_per_driver_per_bucket)` va xac nhan no tinh tren mot o res-9.

tom_tat: Bon cau hoi thiet ke, tra loi bang code + do (30 seed CRN, 3 arm). (a) Ham muc tieu cua S4 KHONG chua mot dai luong nao cua bai toan: `derive_allocation_input` chi chuyen {zone,bucket,capacity} va {driver_id,advice_kind,target,priority_soc} — cau, sd_ratio, cung, khoang cach, tien deu bi cat truoc cua (472/472 lo). Cost = pen + 10 x lech-target, va `pen` khong phu thuoc cot => moi hang cost chi co toi da 2 gia tri (1738/2171 hang co dung 2, 433 con lai vi lo chi 1 zone) => moi o 'sai target' bang nhau tuyet doi. 58,2% luot gan roi vao cai bang nhau do, voi trung binh 11,92 o dich cung cost, va bi day trung binh 2,095 km khoi o gan nhat ma pipeline da tinh. Mot greedy first-fit tam thuong dat DUNG cost toi uu o 472/472 lo => `linear_sum_assignment` khong mua duoc gi. Day chinh la CO CHE giai thich ket qua c9d, va no BAC gia thuyet cua goc: khong co so hang ETA/quang duong nao trong cost ca. (b) Ve 'lay cua nguoi ban' la THAT va do duoc bang cuoc: nhom ban nhat −0,586 cuoc SIG, giua −0,233 SIG, ranh nhat +1,394 SIG; 58,4% CI[46,8%; 71,7%] phan nhom ranh nhat duoc them la LAY TU hai nhom kia. Nhung CO CHE ma goc gia thuyet ('chen o o dich do tran tinh tren o res-9') KHONG duoc ung ho: o nhan nguoi phuc vu THEM +24,67 don SIG, o nguon khong mat gi (ns), va phep thu phoi nhiem bi arm MU SHUF tai tao y het => bien phoi nhiem la bien chon mau. Cung phai ghi nhan chieu nguoc: kenh KHONG phai tong-bang-khong, no tao that +17,27 chuyen/ngay va giam −16,27 don het han (deu SIG). (c) Khong co so hang chi phi co hoi o dau ca; do duoc 2,596 km/luot, 93,7 km rong/ngay/doi, mover mat them 13,75 phut chay rong/ngay SIG — quy ra 24,0 phut chay rong them cho MOI CHUYEN MOI (DERIVED). Tien thi bang 0 dung chinh sach (`cash_cost_vnd_per_km: 0`), nhung THOI GIAN thi khong ai bu va khong metric quyet dinh nao dem. (d) Khong co rang buoc cong bang nao; tieu chi duy nhat chia suat khan (88,0% suat co tran = 1) la SOC — 'nguoi nhieu pin duoc uu tien co hoi', mot chinh sach khong ai tuyen bo. Gini khong xau di (−0,0032 ns) nhung do la tai nan may man, khong phai rang buoc: mot phan ba nhan dien duoc TRUOC khi chay mat −15.290d SIG. Cau tra loi truc tiep cho cau hoi cua goc — 'ai dam bao no khong lam giau nguoi ranh bang tien nguoi ban' — la KHONG AI.
